me:2017:q54-s2.question: During the turning of a 20mm-diameter steel bar at a spindle speed of 400 rpm, a tool life of 20 minute is obtained. When the bar is turned at 300 rpm, the tool lidfe (in minute) is approximately.

detailed_solution.concept: Manufacturing Engineering - Machining and Machine Tool Operation
detailed_solution.markdown:
$$\begin{aligned} V_{1}=\pi D \times 400 \mathrm{m} / \mathrm{min} ; & T_{1}=20 \mathrm{min} \\ V_{2}=\pi D \times 200 \mathrm{m} / \mathrm{min} ; & T_{2}=60 \mathrm{min} \end{aligned}$$

Now using Taylor's equation

$$\begin{array}{l} \qquad V_{1} T_{1}^{n}=V_{2} T_{2}^{n} \\ \text { or } \pi D \times 400 \times(20)^{n}=\pi D \times 200 \times 60^{\text {n }} \\ \text { or } \quad n=0.6309\\ \text { and } \quad V_{3}=\pi D \times 300 \mathrm{m} / \mathrm{min} ; \quad T_{3}=?\\ \qquad V_{1} T_{1}^{n}=V_{2} T_{2}^{n}=V_{3} T_{3}^{n} \\ \pi D \times 400 \times(20)^{0.6309}=\pi D \times 300 \times T_{3}^{0.6309} \\ \therefore \quad T_{3}=31.55 \mathrm{min} \approx 32 \mathrm{min} \end{array}$$

Therefore, the correct answer is **B**.

me:2017:q55-s2.question: In an orthogonal machining with a tool of $9^{\circ}$ orthogonal rake angle, the uncut chip thickness is 0.2mm. The chip thickness fluctuates between 0.25 mm and 0.4 mm. The ratio of the maximum shear angel to the minimum shear angle during machining is _________
